run_zero_shot_protein_eval: run zero-shot evaluation of the ProtST model for protein subcellular localization on Intel Gaudi
tokenize_protein_sequences: tokenize protein sequences using the ESM-1b tokenizer with max length padding and truncation
embed_label_descriptions: embed text label descriptions using the PubMedBERT text model and normalize the features
compute_zero_shot_accuracy: compute zero-shot classification accuracy by matching protein features against label embeddings
wrap_models_in_hpu_graph: wrap the protein and text models in HPU graphs for optimized inference on Intel Gaudi
